[SWS_TcpIp_00380] ⌈If TcpIpTlsUseExtensionTrustedCAKeys is set to TRUE
then the TLS client shall transmit the elements of TcpIpTlsTrustedCAList in its
ClientHello message using the trusted_ca_keys extension according to IETF RFC
6066, chapter 6. Each element of TcpIpTlsTrustedCAList represents a KeyM
root certificate and is referenced by TcpIpTlsTrustedCAListEntry.⌋
